entradas.Aquí no hay representantes: propones ley: There are no representatives here: you propose laws and projects, debate them with amendments and vote. You can delegate your vote to someone who knows a topic and take it back whenever you like. Power is shared among the Legislative (live decisions and Aurora's Council), the Executive (approved mandates and common resources) and the Judicial (constitutionality and Peace Circles to mediate, never to punish).

entradas.Astraura piensa en cuatro capas: local (: Astraura thinks in four layers: local (your device), mesh (your other neurons), cloud and collective. You can turn each one on or off and say how much you prefer local; if you turn the mesh off, nothing goes in or out through it. Heavy work is lent by network servers when your device cannot do it, and your data travels with security layers: your own identity, end-to-end encryption and keys that change by themselves.

Your neurons feed your brain: memories, vaults, connections, AI, permissions and servers. You have one brain per account, with its private side and the public side of your groups and pages; you can merge brains or link them by telepathy without mixing them.
